rot.ideia.ex1.e1: A rook on a rank, or on a file, is a fence. The enemy king cannot cross it.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The black king is on the 5th rank. Close the rank just below it, and it cannot come down.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Cut the king off along a rank, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The rook closes the 4th rank, just below the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes up to h4 and closes the rank just below the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.h1h3.1: That cuts too, but leaves more room for the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.h1h3.2: Look also at h4: the fence just below the king leaves less room.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.h1h2.1: That cuts too, but leaves more room for the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.h1h2.2: Look also at h4: the fence just below the king leaves less room.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h5.1: It is check, but the rook closes nothing below the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h5.2: The king comes down to the 4th rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h5.3: Let's go back: the fence goes just below the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h6.1: The rook closes the rank above the king, not the one below.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h6.3: Let's go back: the fence goes just below the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not close the rank below the king. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Cut the king off along a rank, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Done: the black king cannot enter the 4th rank. Half the board is now forbidden.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember: a rook far from the king, on a rank, is a fence.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: You can also cut along a file. The king stays trapped on one side of the board.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The black king is on the c-file. Close the file just to its right, and it stays trapped on the left.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Cut the king off along a file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The rook closes the d-file, right next to the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes to d1 and closes the file next to the black king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1c1.1: It is check, but the king just changes file.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1c1.2: The king crosses to the right side.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1c1.3: Let's go back: the fence goes on the file next to the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not close the file next to the king. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Cut the king off along a file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king is left with the a-, b- and c-files. The rest of the board is yours.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now I will show the fence in action and what to do if the king attacks the rook.
rot.demos.cerca.e1: The rook on h4 closes the 4th rank. The black king tries to come down.
rot.demos.cerca.l1: The king moves aside, looking for a way through.
rot.demos.cerca.l2: The white king walks up calmly. The rook holds the fence.
rot.demos.cerca.l3: There is no way through: e4, d4 and f4 are on the fence.
rot.demos.outraPonta.e1: The black king came close to the rook and attacks it.
rot.demos.outraPonta.l1: The rook goes to the other end of the rank, far from the king.
rot.demos.outraPonta.l2: The king cannot reach the rook, and the fence holds.
rot.demos.outraPonta.l3: Now it's your turn: cut the king off with the rook.
rot.pratica.fileira.enunciado: Cut off the black king with the rook, on the rank just below it.
rot.pratica.fileira.fim: Well done. The fence just below the king.
rot.pratica.fileira.err.a1a6: It is check, but the king comes down. Try again.
rot.pratica.coluna.enunciado: Close the file just to the king's right. When it moves away, bring the rook one file closer.
rot.pratica.coluna.fim: Perfect. The fence moved up, and the king has less room.
rot.pratica.coluna.err.h1c1: It is check, but the king just changes file. Try again.
